description: This file declares the interface and class definitions for GstCapabilities, which provides information about supported MIME types and capabilities of GStreamer within the Rialto media server component. It includes factory creation methods, capability querying functions, and internal helpers for managing GStreamer caps.

classes.name: GstCapabilitiesFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating GstCapabilities instances, implementing the IGstCapabilitiesFactory interface.

classes.name: GstCapabilities
classes.description: Implements the IGstCapabilities interface, providing methods to query supported MIME types and capabilities of GStreamer.

methods.name: createGstCapabilities
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of IGstCapabilities.

methods.name: getSupportedMimeTypes
methods.description: Returns a list of MIME types supported by GStreamer for a given media source type.

methods.name: isMimeTypeSupported
methods.description: Checks if a specific MIME type is supported by GStreamer.
